name: superops-mcp
description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.

superops_api_token.title: SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN
superops_api_token.description: Sets SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN for the SuperOps MCP server.

superops_subdomain.title: SuperOps subdomain
superops_subdomain.description: Your tenant subdomain (SuperOps: Settings > MSP Information). Sent as the CustomerSubdomain header on every call; requests without it are rejected.

superops_base_url.title: SuperOps API base URL
superops_base_url.description: Base URL for the SuperOps API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

superops_region.title: SuperOps region
superops_region.description: Data-centre region your tenant lives in: us or eu. The wrong region answers with an authentication error.

superops_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
superops_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep the write tools (they still need confirm).

superops_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
superops_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to save no API data locally: sync and workflow archive are refused and the response cache is off. The local-mirror commands still read a store that already exists and never create one. Leave blank to keep the local mirror.

superops_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
superops_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

superops_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
superops_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to SuperOps. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
